corridor.meaning: The surveyed ferry corridor only. It is not an inferred animal path.

effort.meaning: Observation effort attached to the corridor.

observation.meaning: A recorded survey observation. It does not define population, pod, range or migration.

context.meaning: Environmental or human-pressure context kept separate from causal inference.

unknownLaw: Population, pod, live location, migration route and ecological outcome remain UNKNOWN unless independently sourced.
capitalBoundary: Funding may purchase or support verified monitoring effort. Delivery proof must remain separate from ecological outcome claims.
